Its detail_category is already 'school lunch sales', and the statement counts it in Nutrition program receipts 85,982 (69,605 + 6,830 + 9,547), which is category School Lunch Sales. issues.on_page: Revenue from Community Services Activities 55,261 (code 1800, General Fund)
issues.issue: Code 1800 is community services revenue, not student activity receipts. The matching detail line detail[7] uses detail_category 'other charges for services' while its category is Extracurricular Receipts, so the same line is categorized two ways. Charges for services/fees may fit better

The p7 combining schedule shows that 141,310 of this General Fund column amount (31%) is Depreciation Fund 90,663 and Employee Benefit Fund 50,647, both '2900 Other Support Services'. Only 307,304 is pupil support (2100 codes), so detail_category 'Pupils' overstates it
